brief:
Co-founder Batool Abu Akleen, now based in Paris, discussed the launch of Marakeb, a new digital journalism project, with ArabLit. The venture aims to report on issues connected to Gaza and its relationship with the wider world, according to the outlet.

Abu Akleen described the project's focus on covering stories from the port city's perspective and its international dimensions. The newsroom represents an effort to continue Palestinian journalism from outside the territory.
dek: Co-founder Batool Abu Akleen, who is now in Paris, sat down with ArabLit to talk through the new project.
title: Palestinian journalists launch Marakeb digital newsroom from Paris
